cohort_scope: new cohort facility count 30..80, one aggregate treatment block per stage; count growth includes ancillary facilities, not increased cell-level parallel graph complexity
hard_acceptance: all safety/rotation/dimension/coverage checks + all declared main/advanced/sludge gaps + all their head margins; ancillary adjacency excluded
search: phase 1 coordinate/orientation GA plus simultaneous geometric repair and feasible-only compaction; phase 2 original AdvancedGA six-island GA/DE/SA/RL optimizing actual RRP ancillary fill around the independently generated core; feasibility-first selection

constraint_definitions.W_C41: Add 2 m separation when at least one safety level is >=2, with the existing category adjustment retained.
constraint_definitions.W_C45: Apply max(4 m, baseline separation matrix), with the existing category adjustment retained.
constraint_definitions.W_C48: Retain functional categories versus merging conventional/advanced treatment categories in the baseline; soft compactness evaluation, not fixed zoning polygons.
